The initial model-window immune state is estimated with bounded posterior shares anchored by DTP1 initiation, DTP3 completion, reported pre-mean incidence and silent-exposure evidence. Monthly cases use robust peak-balanced likelihood weights: zero or near-zero reporting months are not allowed to dominate the dynamic state, while post-2023 resurgence peak months receive extra objective weight so the fitted mean is judged against outbreak peak shape rather than only against average endemic months.
